answer: Pearl-Delta Jetty scheduling: every coordination request must claim a jetty slot in a delta epoch. A slot is valid only with a pearl—a VDF over the epoch’s sorted request set—so parallel identities must cross-include each other’s intents. To run N sybils concurrently, an attacker must obtain N slots and compute N inclusion proofs over all N intents before the delta closes; serial sybils pay repeated epoch delays and lose amplification. Cost scales with cross-intent verification and slot contention, not just identities.
